title: ClickHouse acl: SQL-driven RBAC -- least-priv app role enforced
description: The nexus-cli acl verb for ClickHouse: SQL-driven RBAC. Verifies the admin + app users exist, the app user (DEFAULT ROLE app_rw = SELECT,INSERT on nexus.*) CAN read/write but CANNOT DROP, and the default user is reachable only from localhost.

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --query 'SELECT name FROM system.users WHERE name IN (''admin'',''app'') ORDER BY name; SELECT name FROM system.roles ORDER BY name'"

observe.what: users admin + app exist; roles app_ro + app_rw exist -- the SQL-driven RBAC seeded by schema-bootstrap

steps.command: APP_PW=$(ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "sudo VAULT_ADDR=$(ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 'grep -oP "address\s*=\s*\"\K[^\"]+" /etc/vault-agent/00-base.hcl|head -1') VAULT_CACERT=/etc/vault-agent/ca-bundle.crt VAULT_TOKEN=\$(sudo cat /var/run/nexus-vault-agent/token) /usr/local/bin/vault kv get -field=password nexus/analytics/clickhouse/app-password"); ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --user app --password '$APP_PW' --query 'SELECT count() FROM nexus.events'"

observe.what: the app user CAN SELECT (returns 600) -- app_rw grants SELECT,INSERT on nexus.*

steps.command: ssh -i $NEXUS_SSH_KEY nexusadmin@192.168.70.44 "clickhouse-client --secure --host localhost --port 9440 --user app --password '$APP_PW' --query 'DROP TABLE nexus.events_local ON CLUSTER nexus_analytics' 2>&1 || echo DENIED_AS_EXPECTED"

observe.what: ACCESS_DENIED / Not enough privileges -> DENIED_AS_EXPECTED -- the least-priv app role cannot DROP (no DROP grant)

whatProves: RBAC is SQL-driven + enforced: the app user has exactly SELECT,INSERT on nexus.* (least privilege) and is denied DDL/DROP; admin holds full grant; the default user is localhost-only. The acl verb manages this surface.
